methods.protocol_description: Differentiated iMGLs from dCAS9-KRAB CRISPRi iPSC line; delivered 3 pairs of sgRNAs targeting FOXO3, HIF1A, and FOXP2. 4 h after sgRNA delivery, cells treated with LPS (10 ng/ml) for 12 h and harvested for snRNA-seq.
